exposure: Induction of labour with a transcervical Foley catheter
cohort: Women with a history of Caesarean delivery undergoing induction of labour with a Foley catheter
finding: Induction of labour with a transcervical Foley catheter in women with a previous Caesarean delivery was effective at achieving vaginal delivery and was associated with a low risk of uterine rupture and maternal and neonatal morbidity.
